title: Height Checker
description:
You are given an array heights representing students’ current positions.

Students should stand in non-decreasing order of height.

Task
Create a sorted version of the array → expected
Count how many indices i where:
heights[i] != expected[i]

Return that count.

Examples

Example 1

[1,1,4,2,1,3]
→ 3

Example 2

[5,1,2,3,4]
→ 5

Example 3

[1,2,3,4,5]
→ 0
input_format:
The first line contains an integer n.
The second line contains n space-separated integers.
